conventions.formatting: Prettier: no semicolons, single quotes, printWidth 100, trailingComma all. .editorconfig: LF, 2-space, final newline. CI runs format:check.
conventions.lint: ESLint 9 flat config: eslint-plugin-vue flat/essential + vue-ts recommended + prettier skip-formatting. No custom rules.
conventions.typescript: tsconfig.base: strict, noUncheckedIndexedAccess, verbatimModuleSyntax, erasableSyntaxOnly (no enums). Relative imports use .ts extension; import type for types. API runs TS natively on Node >=22.18 (ADR 0002).
conventions.naming: Files: camelCase .ts, PascalCase .vue, kebab-case plugin file error-handler.ts. Exports: camelCase, UPPER_SNAKE constants; routes/plugins as xRoutes/xPlugin. Tests colocated *.test.ts in web, apps/api/test/ in API. Pkg scope @crate-digger/*; cookie crate_digger_session.
conventions.modules: API: routes (thin HTTP) / services (plain functions taking (db, input)) / plugins (fastify-plugin) / db. Web: api/ stores/ views/ components/<feature>/ composables/ utils/. Vue script setup. Shared Zod schemas in packages/shared.
conventions.errors: Services throw HttpError (notFound, badRequest) from errors.ts; error-handler plugin emits {statusCode,error,message,issues?}. Web uses errorMessage in api/client.ts.
conventions.commits: Spec says Conventional Commits, squash merge, branches feat/fix/chore. Local history is 1 commit (merge of PR #12), so style is unverifiable from git. No CLAUDE.md or CONTRIBUTING.md.

documentation.product_name: Crate Digger everywhere (display), crate-digger (slug/package scope/image/repo), crate_digger (cookie). No occurrence of 'frisson' in tracked files.
documentation.intent: Self-hosted, manually curated music collection shown as 90s record crates; ADR 0001 says learning project as much as product. Status: milestones through deploy done, polish (M10) next.
documentation.drift: SPEC lists docker-compose.yml, docker/Dockerfile, RecordSleeve/CrateDivider/AddAlbumView, db/migrations/, tokens.css; actual repo has compose.yaml, root Dockerfile, different component names, drizzle/ at apps/api. README is more current than SPEC.

gotchas: Name appears in ~94 places plus Docker image, volume, cookie, package scope, GitHub URL in DEPLOY.md
README and index.html title use emoji/display name; user pref: avoid stray dashes in prose (README uses em dash style)
